assumptions.status: leading triple outer-potential dictionary; not a final theorem

notation.U_outer_expanded: G m_C/R_out + G m_C beta_A r_in cos_Phi/R_out^2 + O(epsilon^2)
notation.beta_A: m_B / M_in, so rho_A = beta_A r_in
notation.clock_rate: d tau_A/dt = 1 - v_A^2/(2 c^2) - alpha_A (U_inner + U_outer)/c^2
notation.inner_bodies: A is the clock pulsar, B is the inner companion

projection.inner_monopole_projector: dt/dE_in = (1 - e_in cos E_in)/n_in; U_inner dt/dE_in integrates to E_in secular plus sin E_in
projection.outer_dipole_kernel: K_dipole = -G m_C beta_A epsilon factor/(a_out c^2)
projection.outer_dipole_projector: Delta_dipole = integral dt K_dipole [(1 - e_in cos E_in)/(1 - e_out cos E_out)^2] cos_Phi
projection.outer_monopole_projector: dt/dE_out = (1 - e_out cos E_out)/n_out; outer monopole integrates to E_out secular plus sin E_out

rows.expansion_order: O(c^-2), Newtonian nested-Kepler carrier, leading nontrivial O(epsilon=a_in/a_out)
rows.notes: GR carrier; U_inner contribution with factor 1. Coordinate-time secular trend is absorbed by spin parameters.

rows.expansion_order: O(c^-2), Newtonian nested-Kepler carrier, leading nontrivial O(epsilon=a_in/a_out)
rows.notes: GR carrier; after secular absorption, residual is proportional to -G e_in m_B (1) sin E_in/(a_in c^2 n_in).
